hack.root_cause: Insider rug — privileged admin withdrawal on behalf of users (MainChef address)
hack.description: Kannagi Finance was a yield aggregator on zkSync Era with $2.1M TVL. The protocol had been audited twice and was endorsed (via a now-deleted giveaway tweet) by SyncSwap, the leading zkSync DEX.
